source: #671: the I/O registers' clocks from every global line: the left and right I/O tiles' GCLKk -> IOIS_CLKj (only line 4 was measured, #44) and the clock tiles' CLKV -> CLKDUB inputs these designs route through; rd / rd2 of gen-iobreg.mjs (IDDR2 / ODDR2 on every pad) with their clock buffer on each of the 8 top / bottom BUFGMUXes in turn (--bufg), implemented by ISE 14.7 on the XC3S250E-CP132 and, for the tile sites its package does not bond, the XC3S100E-CP132 and XC3S1200E-FG320, every PIP removed by codewords (gen-pipdrop.mjs, 20 variants), ana-pipdrop.mjs, pips-to-db.mjs (measure-671.sh); a feature measured in several tiles of one side has the same bits in all, and is given to every I/O tile type of that side (unify-io.mjs's groups)
